positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Streamlined data acquisition process for the development of a reporting application using Tableau, saving $120K/year
• Created voice/text AI assistant to facilitate the onboarding process of new hires, potentially impacting over 300 employees a year
• Developed and implemented back-end server using Node.js that queried an internal resource into the text-based AI assistant

positions.title: Data Analyst Intern
positions.description:
• Analyzed and visualized data for client reporting
• Collaborated with Data Science team in the training of machine learning models to filter through consumer generated content 
• Developed industry-level reports for the R&D department to evaluate industry trends

positions.title: Citi Entrepreneurship Fellow
positions.description:
The Network For Teaching Entrepreneurship provides entrepreneurship education to students from low-income communities

• Provided NFTE Summer Programming with management and implementation support
• Mentored and coached NFTE students during summer programs, impacting over 50 student
• Completed research projects on behalf of local office for NFTE Headquarters and Citi Foundation
